usedFor: Stripe processes payments, and 8x8 texts the customer when “When a payment succeeds” runs “Send SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a payment succeeds” in Stripe, then “Send SMS” in 8x8
bestTemplate.why: A successful payment sends a text, with an optional sender name and delivery reports.

watchOut: “Invoice Is Finalized” and “When a payment succeeds” can both fire for one sale, so a text could go twice.
